findings.title: Popover side can flip while the user types a filter
findings.evidence: MutationObserver on the body calls reposition(true) on every list change; choosePlacement keeps the upward side whenever the whole content fits above (Popover.tsx diff), so a filter that shrinks the list can move the bubble from below to above the trigger.
findings.consequence: Cosmetic jump of the bubble mid-typing in layouts where the trigger has less room above than below; no data or scroll loss.
findings.minimal_fix: Choose the side once at open and re-measure only the height afterwards, or add hysteresis.

findings.title: Sticky filter offset, scrollTop clamp and text-only mutations are not guarded by the tests
findings.evidence: StagePage.css top: -0.5rem on .stage-html-viewer__search is unverified by jsdom; the MutationObserver options are childList and subtree only, so characterData changes do not remeasure; jsdom does not clamp scrollTop, so the save and restore in measureNaturalHeight is not exercised.
findings.consequence: A cosmetic or stale-size regression would pass the unit suite and show only in a real browser.
findings.minimal_fix: Add characterData: true to the observer options and keep the Playwright wheel and count check as a recorded step.

findings.title: Gate pytest exits 1 from a run-as-root environment artifact
findings.evidence: 07-gate.txt lines 82-105: test_an_unwritable_worktree_parent_is_refused 'DID NOT RAISE Refused' under /tmp/pytest-of-root; 1 failed, 1903 passed, 1 skipped. The diff touches no Python.
findings.consequence: Non-zero gate exit unrelated to the phase; could be misread as a phase defect.
findings.minimal_fix: Outside this phase: skip the test when the process runs as root.

findings.title: Audit note refers to the session record and states the grep hit count as nine
findings.evidence: popover-consumer-audit.md says '(review finding, see the session record)' and 'nine' grep hits; at the branch Popover.test.tsx also matches from '.*Popover'.
findings.consequence: A governed working note points readers at a session document and the literal grep count is ten at the branch.
findings.minimal_fix: Remove the session-record pointer and say 'nine consumers (the new test file also matches the grep)'.
